text:
Alex (Partnerships): Quick sync — vendors sent provisional announce windows for H100/H200/B200, MI300, and Gaudi. We need a concrete marketplace SKU cutover + SI dry-run plan and embargo handshake. Can folks confirm constraints by EOD PST?
Priya (Eng): Do we have the kernel/image tag matrix from the vendors yet? perf team needs image tags at least 2w before canary.
Marco (Platform): Not yet. Also we should plan fallback policy: if H100 capacity constrained, fallback to H200->B200 chain. Need throughput numbers per SKU.
Nora (SI Lead): SI teams can do a dry-run, but we need: final SKU list, test harness (prompts + perf targets), and access to lab images. Embargo on public docs until legal signs off.
Elaine (Marketing): Press ops: preferred announce windows? vendor asked for 2025-07-08 or 2025-07-22. We can't pick until legal/partners confirm embargo handoffs. @_Elaine will coordinate embargo times. :calendar:
Sam (Legal): NDA + embargo windows are vendor-specific. I need the exact date/time (TZ) for each vendor, plus any pre-announce partner list. Don't publish partner logos until we have written permission.
Jun (Ops): Lab capacity: we can reserve a 4-week block starting 2025-06-16 for SI dry-run (8x H100, 4x MI300, 6x Gaudi nodes). If vendors provide kernel images by 2025-06-02 we can complete perf runs by 2025-06-30. Booking script:
```
# reserve lab
reserve-lab --cluster dryrun-1 --start 2025-06-16 --duration 28d --nodes h100:8,mi300:4,gaudi:6
```
Priya (Eng): Perf harness note — add KV-cache warmup and sequence-len=1024 stress tests. Also include quantization QA for B200 fallback.
Marco (Platform): Routing plans: we need ability to route by SKU + latency SLO. Ops: can we tag routes in console now so marketing can preview dashboards?
Jun (Ops): Yes, we can create preview routes for canary buckets. Need model names and sample traffic profiles by 2025-06-09.
Nora (SI Lead): For SI dry-run we want a joint troubleshooting window with vendor reps. Can we get a 2-hour slot during the dry-run week dedicated to on-call vendor engineers?
Alex (Partnerships): I'll ask vendors. Action: Alex -> request vendor on-call slots; Priya -> perf harness requirements; Marco -> routing + dashboard preview; Nora -> SI test plan doc; Elaine -> embargo timeline; Sam -> legal signoff checklist; Jun -> lab reservation. Please mark items in the shared doc.
DeployBot: CI:marketplace-image-checks failed on branch feature/sku-cutover (tests: image-tag-format).
Priya (Eng): I'll fix the image-tag lint and push an update.
Elaine (Marketing): One more ask — timeline for marketplace listing assets (icons, descriptions). We need final assets by 2025-06-20 to align with press ops.
Alex (Partnerships): Summary and deadlines: vendor on-call request by 2025-06-01; kernel/image tag matrix by 2025-06-02; model/route names + traffic profile by 2025-06-09; final assets by 2025-06-20; lab dry-run 2025-06-16 -> 2025-07-14. Anything missing?
Sam (Legal): Add vendor-provided embargo email template (I will draft) and legal signoff flow.
Nora (SI Lead): Also request SI runbook for each vendor: install steps, common failure modes, escalations. I'll start a template.
Marco (Platform): Noted. I'll stub the dashboard previews and post a link when ready.
Alex (Partnerships): Thanks team — I'll follow up with vendors and post vendor-confirmed windows here. :thumbsup:
